aboutPage.title: A register we put our name to.
paragraphs: LawMarket is a register of legal services: each carries an exact description, a final price, and an assigned lawyer.
Prices are published in advance and do not change while a matter is under way. What you see in the register is what you pay.
Every completed matter is entered in the lawyer's public case file — this is how the record of experience and reviews accumulates.
We work in the jurisdiction of Georgia, with lawyers who are members of the Georgian Bar Association.
principles: The price is fixed and known in advance.
The matter is performed by a specific, assigned lawyer.
Every order carries a written guarantee.

articles.title: General provisions
articles.body: These terms govern the use of the LawMarket website and the ordering of services. By placing an order you agree to these terms.

articles.title: Services and prices
articles.body: The description and final price of every service are published on its page. The price is fixed and does not change after the order is placed.

articles.title: Ordering and payment
articles.body: Orders are placed without creating an account. Payment is taken through a payment provider; the order reference (e.g. LM-2026-00042) is your receipt.

articles.title: Performance
articles.body: The service is performed by the assigned lawyer named on its page, who will contact you within one business day to confirm the initial details.

articles.title: Guarantee and refunds
articles.body: If the service is not delivered as described, we return the full amount you paid. A refund request is submitted by quoting the case reference.

articles.title: Liability
articles.body: LawMarket's liability is limited to the scope of the ordered service and the amount paid for it.

articles.title: Governing law
articles.body: These terms are governed by the law of Georgia. Disputes between the parties are heard by the courts of Georgia.

articles.title: The data controller
articles.body: Your personal data is processed by LawMarket LLC (Tbilisi, Georgia).

articles.title: What is collected
articles.body: When you place an order or request a consultation we collect: your full name, email address, phone number, and the matter you describe.

articles.title: Purpose and basis
articles.body: Data is processed solely to perform the ordered service and to contact you — the legal basis is the performance of a contract.

articles.title: Disclosure
articles.body: Payment is processed by the payment provider — we never hold card details. The substance of your matter is disclosed only to the lawyer assigned to your case.

articles.title: Retention
articles.body: Order records are kept for as long as tax and legal obligations require; consultation requests for no more than one year.

articles.title: Analytics
articles.body: We use privacy-preserving, cookieless analytics. There are no advertising trackers on this site.

articles.title: Your rights
articles.body: Under the Law of Georgia on Personal Data Protection you may request access to, correction of, or erasure of your data.

articles.title: Contact
articles.body: For data matters, write to privacy@lawmarket.ge (PLACEHOLDER).
